log_level.description: Verbosity level of logs. Valid values: NONE, MAJ, MIN, EVENT, DEBUG, TRACE

protocols.description: List of NFS protocol versions to enable (e.g., 3, 4, 4.1, 4.2)

grace_period.description: Duration (seconds) for the NFSv4 grace period after restart

enable_locking.description: Enable file locking via BSD/POSIX locks (required for NFSv4 locking)

enable_gss.description: Enable RPC security (GSSAPI/Kerberos) for authenticated access

export_default.description: Default settings applied to all exports (override per-export if needed)

path.description: Base filesystem path used for exports (can be overridden per export)

clients.description: List of client hosts/subnets allowed to mount this export (supports CIDR, wildcards)

pseudo.description: Virtual path (namespace) exposed to NFS clients for this export (NFSv4 only)

access_async.description: Allow asynchronous writes (improves performance; may risk data loss on crash)

squash.description: UID/GID squashing policy: 'none' (keep client UIDs), 'root' (map root to nobody), 'all' (map all to nobody)

exports.description: List of exports to configure (minimum 1 required)

export_id.description: Unique numeric ID for this export (required; must be positive integer)

path.description: Absolute filesystem path to export (overrides export_default.path if set)

pseudo.description: Virtual namespace path (overrides export_default.pseudo if set)

fsal.description: Filesystem Abstraction Layer (FSAL) configuration for this export

name.description: FSAL backend: VFS (local filesystem), Ceph (CephFS), or Lustre

fs_id.description: Filesystem ID for VFS FSAL (used in FSAL name resolution)

root_id.description: Root inode number (only needed if root inode != 2)

xattr_name.description: Extended attribute prefix for locking state (VFS only)

ceph_conf.description: Path to Ceph config file (CEPH FSAL only)

lnet_lpid.description: LNet LPID for Lustre FSAL (Lustre network identifier)
